audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart in full/content said Ornn owns Levels 3 and 4-5 and Levels 6 flipped to Urgot, while the packet chart and the whys prose said Skill/Skill, Ornn at 6, and Urgot at 2+ items.
audit.why: phases[N].side and win[N] contradicted the packet levelChart and the whys text on the same rows (whys[2] 'Skill swings here', whys[3] 'Even', whys[4] 'You own 6', whys[6] 'Urgot reclaims it').
audit.corrected: Rows 2,3 -> Skill; row 4 (Level 6) -> Ornn; row 6 (2+ items) -> Urgot, proposed as matched full/content pairs with ratings aligned.

audit.why: Spikes are coherent: Urgot early with Corrosive Charge + Purge, Ornn at 3 and at 6 with Call of the Forge God, Urgot again on percent-HP scaling and the Fear Beyond Death execute.
audit.corrected: Kept the four spikes; sharpened cooldown language elsewhere.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text never named Urgot's abilities beyond 'Disdain (Flip)' and 'his W', and gave no cooldown numbers.
audit.why: Real names and cooldowns: Echoing Flames (P), Corrosive Charge (Q, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8, 800 range), Purge (W, 490 range, self-slow), Disdain (E, 16/15.5/15/14.5/14, 475 range, shields him and flips you), Fear Beyond Death (R, 100/85/70, execute).
audit.corrected: Named the abilities and keyed advice to Disdain's 16s rank-1 cooldown and Purge's 490 range.

audit.why: Disdain is the punishable cooldown at 16s rank 1 / 14s maxed; Fear Beyond Death is 100s at rank 1.

edits.before: His W shreds your HP — W-brittle, dodge his flip. Ornn wins the Disdain cooldown windows.
edits.after: Purge shreds %HP — Brittle him, dodge Disdain. Ornn owns the 16-second Disdain window.

edits.before: - Urgot Disdain: matchup-defining — His engage. E-knock up after it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Disdain (E): 16s at rank 1, 14s maxed — his only engage, and it shields him. Knock him up the moment it whiffs. - Corrosive Charge (Q): 10s, 800-range poke. - Fear Beyond Death: 100s and it executes.

edits.before: Track Urgot's Disdain (Flip): His engage. E-knock up after it. When it is down — W-E + R him.
edits.after: Disdain (E), 16s, flips you and shields him. When it whiffs, W for Brittle then E into your Q pillar.

edits.before: His engage. E-knock up after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Disdain is 16s at rank 1 — bait the flip, then E into your pillar.

edits.before: Urgot wastes Disdain (Flip) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Disdain whiffed — 16 seconds with no escape, so commit the pattern.

edits.before: That is Urgot's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Purge is 490 range and self-slows him — step out and his whole DPS pattern dies.

edits.before: Urgot owns level 1 — his Q shotgun legs poke for free while you have no shield, no combo, and a starved mana bar.
edits.after: Urgot owns 1 — Corrosive Charge pokes from 800 range and Echoing Flames adds free damage while you have no combo.

edits.before: Still his level — his W stutter-step DPS out-trades you before your unstoppable W exists to answer it.
edits.after: Still his — Purge out-DPSes you at 490 range, and your W Brittle is not up yet to punish the stutter-step.

notes: Ornn's W being 'unstoppable' is asserted in several existing strings; Riot's Data Dragon text does not state it, so those strings were left alone rather than repeated or removed. Packet levelChart was used as the tiebreaker against the stored chart because the whys prose agreed with the packet on every disputed row.
